R787.note: mysqli_prepare/bind_param/get_result closes the injection; null-return paths and JSON output unchanged, mysqlnd dependency stated.

R788.note: Closes the vector but by replacing the stored-procedure call with an unrelated SELECT ... WHERE USERNAME = ? - the wrong shape for a sink whose tainted element is the procedure name (needs an allowlist), and every legitimate caller invoking a procedure now gets a user lookup instead; the substitution is stated in the write-up.

R789.note: Captures verify()'s boolean and returns 401 before reading claims; verifier, key, and success-path output unchanged.

R790.note: Overflow-safe two-part bound (length <= size, then offset <= size - length) in the correct order; valid windows yield the same checksum, empty and out-of-range windows return 0 as before, no truncation.

R791.note: Encode.forHtml on the body-context value; '%' is not encoded so the format-string semantics with the constant obj args are preserved, and org.owasp.encoder is named for a version check.

R792.note: Allowlist map is the right shape for an attacker-controlled procedure name, but the placeholder set contains only getValues so any other previously accepted call is rejected; stated openly as a developer follow-up, and the rejection returns 200 with an error string.

R793.note: Adds length <= receivedByteCount - 2 with the subtraction guarded by the existing < 2 check; signature, return value, and success path for fully received messages unchanged.

R794.note: JavaMail Session/Transport/MimeMessage with strict InternetAddress parsing closes CRLF injection, but the rewrite changes what reaches the relay beyond the stated points - the message now carries library-generated From/To/Date/Message-ID/MIME headers the original never sent, and a missing requesterEmail (null) now throws NPE rather than being sent as 'null'.

R795.note: Moving the @PreAuthorize'd delete onto its own bean routes the self-invocation through the proxy so hasRole('ADMIN') is actually evaluated; the only behavioural change is the already-declared ADMIN requirement now applying, and InvoiceService.deleteInvoice keeps its signature as a delegate.

R796.note: HTML::Entities encode_entities applied at the sink to the one free-text field; server-generated id and allowlisted priority left alone, output otherwise identical.

R797.note: Dropping the attacker-populated Decoder.Entity closes the finding, but it also removes the noteLabel feature: any partner document referencing ¬eLabel; now fails with 400 where it previously decoded, which the write-up dismisses as 'no legitimate purpose' rather than stating as a breaking change.

R798.note: assert() now receives the boolean result of $accountType === 'premium' instead of a source string, removing the code-generation path on PHP 7 while keeping the same pass/fail check and return value; the header comment describing the string-eval reliance is left stale.
